_note: Biomes (docs/design/biomes.md section 6 step 3). The farm hub and the five biomes of section 7.1 on the 240 m land (|x| and |z| up to 120 m; x east, z south, the farm at 0, 0). Every number, tint and sign line is a [PLACEHOLDER]. centre and marker are [x, z] in metres. reach_m is how far the biome runs from its centre. bearing_deg is the way out of the farm, 0 up to 360, 0 north (-z), 90 east, clockwise; the farm has none. role is hub (the farm), spoke (a road out of the farm) or open (the Badlands: the open land between the roads, which takes every point no other biome claims). band is the zone-level band the content is tuned for (zones.md section 2), never a gate; the Badlands band is the Earthworks 1 to 30 of biomes.md section 2. tint is a bright colour for the F8 debug overlay (TerrainGround.show_biomes). ground_tint is the colour the real ground leans toward in play (step 5): it multiplies the height tint, then the ground shader multiplies by its base (0.42, 0.5, 0.3), so it is a pale or dark multiplier, never a final colour; white (the farm) changes nothing. sign is the soft-gate warning on the biome's marker (a sign and a 4 by 4 m rover pad; information, never a wall) and names no key. entrances lists the zones that start in the biome: {zone, at}, zone a zones.json id (each claimed once) and at where the way in is, or null when it is not placed yet; the second ways in (colony_mine, deimos) and the unplaced ones are [PLACEHOLDER]. Existing places stay where they are: the tunnel mouth (20.5, -19) belongs to the Basalt Ridge, the relay (-70, -70) and the whole relay road (x = z) to the Lab Quarter after the farm, and the Aquifer sinkhole is new, in the Badlands (Question 12). Each marker's 4 by 4 m pad keeps clear of the plot, the built things and rocks, the relay road, and every other marker, and stands on ground that varies under 0.25 m (the old land's heights cannot change, so the pads go where it is near flat). Read by scripts/world/biome_data.gd; nothing in play reads it yet.

biomes.name: Farm
biomes.sign: Farm: grow, water, harvest and sleep. Everything starts here.

biomes.name: Lab Quarter
biomes.sign: Lab Quarter: lab level 1 to 20. Instruments, standards and the relay road.

biomes.name: Badlands
biomes.sign: Badlands: Earthworks level 1 to 30. Hills and pits. Deep holes seep water.

biomes.name: Basalt Ridge
biomes.sign: Basalt Ridge: lab level 5 and up. Dark ground, cold nights. The tunnels start here.

biomes.name: Frost Flats
biomes.sign: Frost Flats: lab level 18 and up. Ice, long drives, a heater for the rover.

biomes.name: Landing Field
biomes.sign: Landing Field: lab level 20 and up. The shuttle leaves from here, with a license.
